text:
zoe-partnerships: Heads-up: CloudHarbor wants to go live in southern-gale1 via marketplace. Need SKU entitlements, CMEK pattern, and a greenlight window for a co-announcement. cc @sam-sales @anya-partner-success
martin-eng: paste the partner SKU slugs + expected steady/peak throughput and i'll validate mapping to our instance families.
leo-ops: note: southern-gale1 has a default soft quota of 80 vGPUs for new partners. quota bump needs ~2 business days.
zoe-partnerships: initial ask from partner: chb.A100V.large x16 and chb.ctrl.small x6. target steady ~100 rps, burst ~320 rps.
martin-eng: ok. need the exact slugs to bake into infra and cert playbooks.
anya-partner-success: slugs exported from CloudHarbor portal: chb.a100v.large, chb.ctrl.small. i've uploaded to shared partner folder.
zoe-partnerships: KMS: CloudHarbor requires partner-managed CMEK for marketplace images. @yasmin-legal any no-go language?
yasmin-legal: we won't hand over our master KMS. Partner-managed CMEK is acceptable if customer BYOK. i'll prepare a 1-paragraph addendum that: confirms tenant key ownership, prohibits key material export, and defines audit scope. ETA ~24h.
sam-sales: CloudHarbor marketing asked for a coordinated announcement within 12 days after capacity confirmation. is that feasible?
leo-ops: ops timeline: if quota request goes today and is approved in 48h, soft lift ~72h. SLA-backed dedicated pools (certs/procurements) around 10-14 days.
martin-eng: blockers: 1) quota ticket id, 2) validated CMEK image pull, 3) routing entry for southern-gale1. i'll open infra PR once ticket + slugs in thread.
zoe-partnerships: opening quota ticket now via chbctl:
```bash
chbctl quota request --region southern-gale1 --sku chb.a100v.large --qty 16 --reason "Redwood Dedicated initial pool for CloudHarbor marketplace launch"
```
zoe-partnerships: created ticket CHB-TKT-4417 (linked to this thread). please reference in PRs.
martin-eng: got CHB-TKT-4417. i'll start the preflight matrix and draft infra changes.
anya-partner-success: partner requires a smoke run: model pull and 60 requests with p50 <160ms. i'll coordinate the window.
yasmin-legal: adding embargo clause: no external announcement until addendum signed and capacity validated. will post draft.
sam-sales: will prep co-marketing assets but hold publishing.
deploy-bot: Region checklist created: r/infrastructure/regions/southern-gale1/checks - status: pending (autoscaler, routing, certs, kms).
leo-ops: cost note: CloudHarbor A100 spots vary; recommend a temporary budget cap alert and spend webhook for the initial pool.
martin-eng: ack. infra PR will include tags partner:cloudharbor, billing alerts, and an autoscaler profile tuned for 320rps burst.
zoe-partnerships: timeline recap: CHB-TKT-4417 opened; legal addendum by @yasmin-legal in 24h; infra PR by @martin-eng in ~48h; partner smoke test by @anya-partner-success within 72h. soft-launch announcement target in 7-12 days depending on legal/sign-off. objections?
yasmin-legal: none from legal side. will ping when draft ready.
sam-sales: all good. holding public comms.
anya-partner-success: collecting partner logo, short description, and verification badge for the marketplace tile. will upload assets.
martin-eng: preflight checklist (short): 1) provision reserved pool (16x a100v) 2) verify CMEK-backed image pulls + model load 3) perf smoke: 60 reqs, p50 <160ms 4) autoscaler responds to 320rps burst 5) routing fallback to us-central if capacity exhausted 6) billing tags and budget alerts validated
zoe-partnerships: thanks all. i'll update when legal draft or quota status changes. tagging #southern-gale1-cloudharbor for visibility. :sparkles:
